name: Boiler Room of Ambient Honesty
description: The warm basement where the Castle's truths are pressurized and piped through the vents.
environment_gags: Pipes are labeled HOT TAKE and COLD STORAGE.
The valve marked 'do not exaggerate' is fully open.

jokes.setup: Why is the Castle always warm?
jokes.punchline: Safety Siren: 'BECAUSE HONESTY IS EXOTHERMIC. ALSO THERE MAY BE A FIRE. THERE IS NO FIRE.'

jokes.setup: The thermostat asks the room how it feels.
jokes.punchline: Emotional Weather: 'Forecast: humid candor. 70% chance of sincerity by midnight.'

interactions: Turn a valve to change the room's mood.
Ask Safety Siren to calibrate the alarm. Gently.
